blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Fans of American pop-rock band LANY were left disappointed after the group’s much-anticipated Cebu concert was postponed on Thursday, November 12, the same day it was scheduled to take place. The last-minute announcement caught concertgoers off-guard, particularly those who had already made preparations and travel arrangements to see the band perform. Following the announcement, some fans took to social media to air their disappointment. Some pointed out that fans had travelled all the way to Cebu specifically for the concert.
